pll2d15c3-d1e3519.summary: Asks whether poisonous and harmful animals were created after man's sin for punishment, or were created harmless and began to harm sinners (Augustine).

pll2d15c3-d1e3530.summary: Answers with Augustine that they would have harmed nothing had man not sinned; they began to harm to punish and deter vices or to prove and perfect virtue; created harmless, they became harmful because of sin.
claims: Harmful creatures were created harmless; sin made them harmful.

pl-l2d15c3.summary: Asks whether poisonous and harmful animals were created after man's sin as punishment, or were created harmless and began to harm sinners. With Augustine, they would have harmed no one had man not sinned; they began to harm to punish and deter vices or to test and perfect virtue. Created harmless, they became harmful because of sin.
claims: They became harmful because of sin.
They harm to punish vice or to test and perfect virtue.
